entry_points.summary: Three invocation forms: chain form, preset:<name> form, and resume <RUN_ID> form; chain is comma/arrow-separated step names without /z- prefix
New-run setup: derive slug, resolve plan dir, preflight slug-collision check, acquire flock-based lock, build AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE, init overnight-state.json, log overnight_start
Lock file at $BASE/.overnight.lock (JSON: owner_run_id, started_at, last_heartbeat); flock file at $BASE/.overnight.flock; stale threshold Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_LOCK_STALE_S (default 7200s)
Merge OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT with Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE (JSON string); exported as Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE before Skill calls
Resume: locate state file, parse, compute cursor = first non-complete step, validate HEAD SHA against last completed step head_sha_after (warn-and-continue on mismatch), re-acquire lock

Per-step: skip if complete, update state to running, log step_start, snapshot archive dirs, set Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt, invoke Skill, unset Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK, identify sub-RUN via C14 algorithm, classify via run-status.sh, write state, log terminal event, break on non-complete
If archive-dir snapshot finds 0 or >1 new dirs after Skill call, emit run_id_ambiguous as a top-level event (to overnight run_id), set STEP_STATUS=error, jump to terminal handling
Best-effort terminal: determine overall status, update state, invoke morning-report.py, log overnight_end, release lock, push-notify via should-notify
Invokes python3 scripts/morning-report.py <slug>; failure logged as morning_report_failure event; lock release proceeds regardless

Subcommands: classify <run-id> [--command <name>] -> clean | halted | errored | unknown; last-event <run-id> -> last event JSON. HALT allowlist includes overnight_lock_corrupt. classify reads last 20 lines of events.jsonl, tolerates malformed trailing JSON
Converts [~] markers in TASKS.md to [ ] atomically; called by /z-implement-all when halt-from-ask fires mid-batch so resume re-runs the interrupted task
check-collisions: if first step is plan OR research and $BASE/PLAN.md exists, emit slug_collision_halt event and exit nonzero; runs before lock acquisition and before Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK is set
Post-processes the resolve-question envelope under Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt: allowlist match -> overnight_decision envelope; no match -> halt envelope. Fires only when result==ask
Returns True when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt AND either Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE or Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE is non-empty (frozen policy active)
Emits unhandled_gate event via log-event.sh for a registered gate not covered by the frozen policy; non-fatal, skips if Z_HARNESS_RUN unset

check-no-ask --question-id <id>: returns JSON {result: halt|proceed|unhandled_gate, question_id, rule_id}; unhandled_gate fires when policy mode is active and a registered gate is not covered by the frozen allowlist
Default allowlist: {workflow.slug_confirm: recommend_derived, workflow.audit_to_amend: amend}; merged under Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE env override

Pre-run gate for benchmark policy-mode runs (make bench-autonomy-check): step 1 asserts quick-build hot-path AskUserQuestion callsites are registered; step 2 asserts frozen policy covers every hot-path gate. Exit 0 required before unattended policy-mode run

invariants: Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt is set ONLY around Skill-tool calls (Phase 3.6) and unset immediately after; parent orchestrator AskUserQuestion calls (lock contention, resume confirmation) run with NO_ASK unset
Hard halts (slug collision, lock corruption, state corruption) are NEVER bypassed by the overnight allowlist or halt-from-ask; they exit before lock acquisition
overnight-state.json writes are always flock-guarded on $BASE/.overnight.lock via tmp+rename (POSIX atomic)
Lock is released in Phase 4.5 even if MORNING_REPORT.md write fails (best-effort ordering)
No retry on Skill-tool failure; user resumes via /z-overnight resume <RUN_ID>
git_diff_stat_at_end is captured at EVERY terminal state transition (complete, halt, error), not only on chain completion
Empty chain -> usage error; no lock acquired (Phase 0 guard)
would_have_asked in halt envelope captures only {default, choices} — never question text, description, or header
Allowlist env override (Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE) is a JSON object merged over defaults, not a replacement
Preflight slug-collision check runs BEFORE lock acquisition and BEFORE Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK is set; triggers when first step is plan OR research and PLAN.md already exists

New sub-RUN identification uses set-difference of archive dirs excluding *-overnight-* dirs (C14 algorithm); 0 or >1 new dirs emits run_id_ambiguous as top-level event (to overnight run_id) then errors the step
run-status.sh classify tail-reads last 20 events and tolerates malformed trailing JSON; no valid events -> unknown
Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 AND Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt is a rejected config conflict; emits config_conflict event and exits nonzero
morning-report.py is invoked directly (not inlined) in Phase 4.3; failure is advisory-only and does not block lock release
overnight_lock_corrupt is in the HALT events allowlist in run-status.sh classify
Policy mode (fail-closed H4): cmd_check_no_ask returns unhandled_gate instead of halt when _is_policy_mode() is true and a registered gate is not covered by the frozen allowlist
Hard-halt list and truly-unregistered gates (path 4: unknown_ask_blocked) are never promoted to unhandled_gate even in policy mode
bench-autonomy-check.sh (make bench-autonomy-check) must exit 0 before any unattended policy-mode overnight run; it checks callsite registration AND policy gate coverage
gotchas: Fail-OPEN for unregistered callsites: AskUserQuestion callsites not in QUESTION_IDS will block the conversation even with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt. Use make bench-autonomy-check before policy-mode runs; use scripts/lint-askuser.sh --strict before standard overnight runs
unhandled_gate result from cmd_check_no_ask is a LOUD abort signal distinct from halt: orchestrators must abort the run, not merely stop the step; it means the frozen policy is incomplete

Policy mode is active when BOTH Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt AND Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE (or Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE) is non-empty; setting NO_ASK=halt alone without an allowlist does NOT activate policy mode
bench-autonomy-check.sh step 2 imports zharness_pier.policy from z-harness/bench/pier; the pier package must be present. Use --policy <path> to override the default benchmark-autonomy.yaml location
Preflight now triggers on first step = plan OR research (not just plan); research-build preset will halt if PLAN.md already exists
Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE value must be a JSON object string, not comma-separated key=value pairs
Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE is an internal export; visible via config.py inspect-all; do not set manually — the orchestrator overwrites it
Lock stale threshold defaults to 7200s (2h) because /z-implement-all may not yield control for extended periods; heartbeat fires only at step transitions, not inside Skill calls

run-status.sh classify for implement-all requires --command implement-all flag because /z-implement-all emits implement_end per task rather than a single chain-end event; classify then also checks TASKS.md checkbox state
HEAD SHA mismatch on resume surfaces a CRITICAL warning but proceeds (warn-and-continue, not a hard halt)
z_harness_version in overnight-state.json is stored for record only; it is NOT validated on resume
would_have_asked field in halt envelope is restricted to {default, choices} to prevent leakage of context strings into events.jsonl
MORNING_REPORT.md is overwritten on every chain run; previous reports are not archived automatically
Lock file is both the concurrency lock AND the flock target for overnight-state.json writes (single lock per C4); do not use a separate flock file
Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTO_COMPACT=1 only logs a compact_recommended event; it does not trigger automatic context compaction — the caller must observe the event
morning-report.py finds the latest overnight run by lexical sort of *-overnight-* dirs in the archive; if the wrong run is selected, MORNING_REPORT.md will reflect it silently
run_id_ambiguous is a top-level event emitted to the overnight run_id (not the sub-run), so it appears in the overnight events.jsonl even when the sub-run cannot be identified

event_vocabulary.implement_all_halt: {reason, question_id, rule_id} — reserved kind recognized by run-status.sh; v1 uses task_halt per-task; reserved for a future batch-level halt event
event_vocabulary.unhandled_gate: {question_id, reason} — emitted by _emit_unhandled_gate when policy mode is active and a registered gate is not covered by the frozen allowlist

bench_autonomy_check.step1: lint-askuser --strict scoped to commands/z-plan.md and commands/z-implement-all.md; asserts AskUserQuestion callsites are paired with resolve-question or check-no-ask
bench_autonomy_check.step2: policy coverage assertion: loads z-harness/bench/pier/benchmark-autonomy.yaml via zharness_pier.policy.load_policy; checks every workflow.* gate referenced in z-plan.md, z-implement-all.md, z-implement-next.md is present in policy gates map

v1_deferrals: Full retrofit of every AskUserQuestion callsite to halt-aware gates (v1: instrumented set only; rest are fail-OPEN)
Subprocess-per-step architecture (v1 uses Skill-tool composition; context accumulation risk for step 4+)
Auto-compact trigger (v1 only logs compact_recommended event)
Stale-lock hard-block (v1 relies on heartbeat + 2h timeout; no PID/conversation-id check)
